text:
alex: Quick check — I'm seeing a ~3% EM regression on the tiny RAG QA eval when moving from int8 -> fp8 for rw-13b-infer:v2. Batch=8, seq=512, kv-cache enabled. Can someone run a focused micro-bench for int4/int8/fp8 with identical seed/tokenization? Need latency (p50/p95), tokens/sec, and EM/F1 on tiny-rag-eval-5k. ping @sara @mike

sara: I can take this tonight. Which exact checkpoint + kernel? Also clarify quant codepath (our native FP8 vs third-party).

alex: Model: redwood/rw-13b-infer:v2. Kernel: branch perf/kv-cache-fix. Quant configs: int8 (q8f), int4 (q4n, per-channel), fp8 (e4m2) using our native fp8 branch. Dataset: tiny-rag-eval-5k (path /mnt/bench/tiny-rag-eval-5k). Seed=42. Continuous batching on.

mike: I'll profile memory and allocator. Command I'll run: ```python -m bench.run --model redwood/rw-13b-infer:v2 --quant int8 --batch 8 --seq 512 --dataset /mnt/bench/tiny-rag-eval-5k --seed 42 --out /tmp/bench_int8.json``` I'll collect nvprof + allocator traces.

jamie: FYI last canary added a kernel tweak that can increase activation peaks for fp8 (scale init change). Could explain quality blip if scales diverge. Watch logs for SCALE_INIT / SCALE_STEP entries.

lisa: I'll handle the quality metrics and diffing. Use temp=0.0, max_tokens=256 for deterministic gen. I'll run EM/F1 and also produce per-sample diffs for the top 50 regressions.

ci-bot: job queued: bench-run/1785001250 (est runtime ~2h). logs: https://ci.redwood/bench/1785001250

mike: quick update — int8 micro-bench done: p50=120ms, p95=280ms, tokens/sec=450. Dumped nvprof and /tmp/bench_int8.json. Starting fp8 now.

sara: I'll run int4 next and produce predictions so we can compare with difftool. Use /scripts/compare_preds.py to pair outputs.

mike: fp8 run finished: p50=98ms, p95=210ms, tokens/sec=510. EM dropped by 3.2% on the tiny eval (seed 42). Allocator peaks slightly higher for fp8.

alex: Oof. Can you capture token-level divergence for the failed samples and mark which stage diverged (first token vs later)? Put diffs + nvprof in artifact dir and tag examples with "fp8-hurt". If EM delta > 2% we shouldn't auto-roll fp8 into release.

sara: Copying outputs to /artifacts/quant-checks/1785001234/ and running diffs now. I'll also extract KV-cache collision counters.

jamie: cc @eng-ml for visibility — might be a quant-scale calibration issue rather than kernel perf.

lisa: Uploaded quality csv + top-50 diffs to the artifact path. Noting that many divergences are in long-context generative answers (after token ~120).

mike: NVProf traces show extra memcpy around KV cache flush with fp8 kernel. I suspect a small path that reorders ops and influences float scaling.

alex: Next steps: 1) consolidate artifacts 2) run 1k-sample overnight with same configs (int8/int4/fp8) 3) eng-ml to review scale calibration 4) if fp8 still loses >2% EM on 1k, rollback for the release. Thanks all, leave notes in this thread. :thumbsup:
